notes: Site exposes a genuine New Arrivals parent listing at /new-arrivals with 7 real site-defined children (visible in main nav flyout and confirmed live): New Collectibles, New Furniture, New Gift Ideas, New Herend, New Home Decor, New Jewelry, New Tabletop. All 8 URLs (parent + 7 children) are real shoppable PLPs (sort/filter/pagination, breadcrumb Home > New Arrivals > <child>, product grids with titles/prices confirmed by reading rendered HTML). Site is a NetSuite SCA Backbone.js SPA (plain HTTP returns an empty shell); qty for every row was read from the site's own rendered listing-header element .facets-facet-browse-title[data-quantity], captured via Playwright and cross-checked twice (identical values across two independent runs) and, for New Furniture, additionally cross-checked against a literal '22 Products' <h4> heading and a manual count of 22 product tiles in the rendered grid. Note the parent 'New Arrivals' qty (194) is LESS than the sum of the 7 children (207) -- this is expected/documented cross-listing overlap (a product can appear under more than one New Arrivals child, e.g. a Herend piece that is also tagged Home Decor), not a data error; the parent qty is recorded as the site's own aggregate count for that listing, not a sum of children. Checked main nav, footer nav, and sitemap.xml for New In/Just In/Latest Arrivals/What's New/Recently Added synonyms -- found none beyond the /new-arrivals tree (sitemap only indexes the canonical /new-arrivals/sub-new-arrivals/* paths, which 200-redirect-equivalent to the shorter nav URLs used here; both resolve to the same rendered listing). No ambiguous 'New Collection' marketing pages found -- every /new-arrivals/* page is a genuine filterable product grid, not editorial content.
